scenes.label: Hook

visual.prompt: A tall glass fund-house tower at dusk filling the frame, thin golden streams of coins flowing into it from thousands of tiny lit homes below, while a faint red falling arrow cuts across the sky, dramatic and slightly ominous

scenes.vo: Aapki SIP doobe, phir bhi fund house kyun kamata hai?

scenes.label: Setup

visual.prompt: WIFE at a kitchen table at night with the house budget notebook and a bank passbook, ticking off the monthly SIP entry, calm and content, warm lamp light

scenes.vo: Har mahine salary aate hi SIP kat jaati hai. Wife ko lagta hai, yeh paisa sirf hamare liye kaam karta hai.

scenes.label: The choice

visual.prompt: Living room in the evening, PAPA in a kurta holding FD receipts, worried, pointing at a TV showing a big red downward arrow, WIFE calmly shaking her head with a firm smile

scenes.vo: Market gira, Papa bole SIP band karo. Wife ne chalu rakhi, plan lambi daud ka tha.

scenes.label: The belief

visual.prompt: Dreamlike panel: the family and a suited fund manager rowing together in one small wooden boat on a calm river at sunrise, everyone smiling, sharing the same oars

scenes.vo: Unka logic seedha tha, hum kamayenge tabhi fund wale kamayenge.

scenes.label: What really happened

visual.prompt: A grand fund-house office building in daylight, long lines of small families walking up its steps carrying coin jars, the vault doors inside glowing gold, busy and impressive

scenes.vo: Nippon Life India lakhon logon ki SIP sambhalti hai. Andaza tha, July-September ka munafa 4.22 billion rupaye.

scenes.label: The cost

visual.prompt: A big family coin jar with a small ticking meter attached, a steady trickle of coins dripping into the fund house vault, behind it a stormy sky with a jagged up and down line, the meter never stops

scenes.vo: Pichhle saal se 22.3 percent zyada. Kyunki fees har din kat-ti hai, market gire ya chadhe.

scenes.label: The twist

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt at the dinner table holding a magnifying glass over a printed fund statement, WIFE and PAPA leaning in, surprised, night, warm light

scenes.vo: Aap partner nahi, customer ho. Expense ratio dekho, yaani saal bhar ki fees. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: Send

visual.prompt: Two young friends at a roadside chai stall in the evening, one explaining with open hands, the other wide-eyed and laughing in realisation, steam rising from glasses

scenes.vo: Us dost ko bhejo jo sochta hai fund wale bhi saath doobte hain.
